messages:
anya: quick ask — can we show a tiny cost-preview when hovering SKUs in Console? show est. delta for token cost + cache savings if you change routing (sticky vs rr).

sam: yes pls. would avoid surprise bills during rollouts. :thumbsup:

pranav: doable but note cache savings are noisy. include sample_rate and a variance hint.

katie: UX wants a short headline (e.g. "~$0.30/day") and an expandable micro-breakdown (per-model, cache vs model-run).

maria: ops: we need to throttle this. previews will spike during experiments. recommend caching for 60s and per-user rate limits. also per-org opt-out flag.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: agree 60s LRU cache. internal cache endpoint exists; require X-Internal-Key.

sam: API sketch: GET /internal/console/cost_preview?route=R123&policy=sticky&window=7d returns model_summaries, token_delta, est_cost_delta_unit, sample_rate, decision_id, freshness_flag. UI formats currency.

pranav: include a warmup projection for sticky routing (0-24h) so users see short-term negative delta until cache warms.

katie: we'll add a tiny 24h sparkline for that and a "view assumptions" link.

maria: action items: eng prototype API + 60s cache; frontend mock; product finalize copy; ops add flag + rate limits. I'll open the GH issue and link mock.

anya: thanks — tag me on the PRs.
